reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper and adds no parallel lookups; every link handler shares the one new guard.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinked; each handler only adds a three-argument call (the provider string repeats the literal the handler already uses).

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers it protects, before any side effects.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: A small, well-named guard with explicit parameters that a new provider can call in one line.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five *-accounts-link handlers call the guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
